name: Roman's Pizza Kraaibosch
address: Knysna Rd, Knysna & Kraaibosch, Estate Road, George, 6546, South Africa
description_short: Reliable pizza chain serving familiar favourites for quick takeaways and casual family meals in George.
description_long:
Roman's Pizza Kraaibosch brings the familiar comfort of a trusted South African pizza chain to George's Kraaibosch area. Located conveniently on Knysna Road, it's the go-to spot when you need a quick, satisfying meal without fuss.

The menu covers all the classics—from their signature Chicken Mayo to meaty Triple-Decker options—with consistent quality that families and students rely on. It's built for takeaway, though there's space to eat in if you prefer. The pizzas are generous, the prices won't sting, and you know exactly what you're getting.

Perfect for weeknight dinners when no one feels like cooking, casual lunches, or feeding a group without breaking the bank. It's straightforward, affordable pizza done well.
